description:
Create a time block on a day's timeline. The block is auto-placed in the earliest free gap large enough for it (same first-fit engine as the app); pass anchor_time to pin it at a fixed hour instead. Its "b:<id>" ref is inserted into the day's timeline_order for you — never write timeline_order by hand.

A block can be about people and pages (contact_ids, company_ids, tag_ids), like a task: "Meeting #Keepsake Dev# with @Romain Dupont@" links the page and Romain from its title alone. A note created for the block inherits them.

anchor_time.description: Pin the block at a fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM (it becomes a wall other blocks flow around). Omit for automatic first-fit placement.

company_ids.description: Companies linked to the block (company ids). Replaces the list.

contact_ids.description: People linked to the block (contact ids). Replaces the list. A title with @Name@ also links that person.

duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes (default 30 for an activity, 60 for a bucket)

filter_due.description: Task buckets only: which tasks to show, by due date — today, overdue (today only), week (from this day to Sunday), asap, someday, all. null = the day's tasks (today + overdue + ASAP on today), the default. Every bucket shows ALL the open tasks matching its filter, even if another bucket shows them too; the app displays what fits in the block's duration (15 min per task without a duration) and the rest under « show more ».

filter_tag_id.description: Task buckets only: show only the tasks linked to this page (tag id, from list_tags). null = all pages.

note.description: Text of the block's note: a real note is created (kept out of the Inbox) and linked to the block. Supports #tag#, [[tag]] and @Name@. To attach an existing note, use link_day_block_note.

tag_ids.description: Pages linked to the block (tag ids, from list_tags). Replaces the list. A title with #page# or [[page]] also links that page (created if needed).

type.description: 'block' = activity (default). 'tasks' = task bucket: a window that shows tasks — by default the day's untimed tasks, or what filter_tag_id / filter_due select.

name: create_day_block
